mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_subscriptions (user_id, sub_type, sub_value) VALUES (#{userId}, #{subType}, #{subValue})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification_subscriptions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, sub_type, sub_value, created_at FROM notification_subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
